classification_basis: Source route tracing, not newly executed Android runtime coverage.

rows.reachability: conditional insertion via page truncation; Copy credit precondition guarded
rows.trigger: requestUrl rejects a non-artwork page. Copy credit validates the same page first. Insertion validates the full page, then page.take(4096) can remove a late title=File: query parameter from an otherwise valid /w/index.php artwork URL before requestUrl.
rows.planned_test: Direct requestUrl(non-file page); normal invalid-page action rejected with zero requests; then a valid index.php artwork URL with title=File: after offset 4096 through the real insertion callback, fake successful original image response, and assert the localized requestUrl precondition failure after page truncation. This is route characterization, not a validation change.
rows.status: open; inventory and plan only; no implementation or translation applied
